claim.claim-text: 1. A method in a User Equipment, UE, for NR, comprising:
2. The method according to claim 1, wherein at least one reference signal of the M reference signals is transmitted by the second serving cell.

3. The method according to claim 2, wherein of the M configuration information blocks each configuration information block corresponding to a reference signal transmitted by the first serving cell comprises an index of the first serving cell; of the M configuration information blocks each configuration information block corresponding to a reference signal transmitted by the second serving cell comprises an index of the second serving cell; the index of the first serving cell and the index of the second serving cell are respectively composed of Q1 bits and Q2 bits, Q1 and Q2 being different positive integers.

4. The method according to claim 1, comprising: receiving first information on a target serving cell (S201, S501); wherein the first information indicates a first time-frequency resource pool, the first time-frequency resource pool is a CORESET or a search space; the first time-frequency resource pool comprising a positive integer number of time-frequency resource block(s), the W time-frequency resource block(s) belongs(belong) to a section of the first time-frequency resource pool that is located in a first time window, and the target serving cell is added by the UE.
5. The method according to claim 1, wherein the first serving cell is maintained by a TRP.
6. A User Equipment, UE, for NR, comprising:
7. The UE according to claim 6, wherein at least one reference signal of the M reference signals is transmitted by the second serving cell.

8. The UE according to claim 7, wherein of the M configuration information blocks each configuration information block corresponding to a reference signal transmitted by the first serving cell comprises an index of the first serving cell; of the M configuration information blocks each configuration information block corresponding to a reference signal transmitted by the second serving cell comprises an index of the second serving cell; the index of the first serving cell and the index of the second serving cell are respectively composed of Q1 bits and Q2 bits, Q1 and Q2 being different positive integers.

9. The UE according to claim 6, wherein the first receiver receives N reference signal(s); wherein N is a positive integer, measurement(s) on the N reference signal(s) being used to trigger a transmission of the first radio signal.

10. The UE according to claim 6, wherein the first receiver receives first information on a target serving cell; wherein the first information indicates a first time-frequency resource pool, the first time-frequency resource pool is a CORESET or a search space; the first time-frequency resource pool comprising a positive integer number of time-frequency resource block(s), the W time-frequency resource block(s) belongs(belong) to a section of the first time-frequency resource pool that is located in a first time window, and the target serving cell is added by the UE.
11. The UE according to claim 6, wherein the first serving cell is maintained by a TRP.
12. A base station for NR, comprising:

13. The base station according to claim 12, wherein at least one reference signal of the M reference signals is transmitted by the second serving cell, the base station being a maintenance base station for the second serving cell.

14. The base station according to claim 13, wherein of the M configuration information blocks each configuration information block corresponding to a reference signal transmitted by the first serving cell comprises an index of the first serving cell; of the M configuration information blocks each configuration information block corresponding to a reference signal transmitted by the second serving cell comprises an index of the second serving cell; the index of the first serving cell and the index of the second serving cell are respectively composed of Q1 bits and Q2 bits, Q1 and Q2 being different positive integers.

15. The base station according to claim 12, wherein the second transmitter transmits first information on a target serving cell, wherein the first information indicates a first time-frequency resource pool, the first time-frequency resource pool is a CORESET or a search space; the first time-frequency resource pool comprising a positive integer number of time-frequency resource block(s), the W time-frequency resource block(s) belongs(belong) to a section of the first time-frequency resource pool that is located in a first time window, and the target serving cell is added by the transmitter of the first radio signal.
